sections.heading: The mismatch
sections.text: CTM's thought representation is compact; super-resolution needs a dense spatial field.

sections.heading: What came before
sections.text: CTM carries a compact thought state and no spatial field at all. A window-wise adaptation pools each window down to one summary token, which fits the thought block but throws away position. This work keeps one query per position instead.

sections.heading: Method
sections.text: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.

sections.heading: Results
sections.text: Competitive with CNN baselines; behind recent lightweight transformers.

sections.heading: What to take away
sections.text: A dense carrier held across ticks and read by a compact thought process matches CNN baselines at a comparable parameter count. The strongest recent lightweight transformers remain ahead, and the gains flatten after about four ticks.
